Use case: identity-preserve. Asset: WHOLE-FIGURE pixel-art locomotion sprites for the existing native64 square-grid roguelike. Input1 is the exact identity, anatomy, proportions, colors and projection master. Input2 is a movement guide ONLY or the same creature's opposite view, as specified below. Keep the exact master species; do not copy the guide creature's identity.
Layout EXACTLY THREE equal columns and THREE equal rows. Eight separate complete figures in row-major order form one smooth, restrained 800ms cycle (400ms per advancement), followed by a ninth fully grounded idle. Identical camera, scale, framing and proportions throughout. Every entire silhouette including tail, claws and head is safely inside its own cell, with generous clear transparent margins; no overlap or clipping.
Draw coherent complete figures in each pose, with the head, torso and appendages attached naturally. Restrained compact movement, continuous weight support, tiny vertical bob; no detached sliding parts, no bouncing or shaking head. Retain the master's LOW silhouette and native width/height ratio. Preserve the exact count of limbs and the master asymmetries.
Crisp deliberate pixel clusters and dark outlines, muted matte colors EXACTLY matching input1. Preserve material area coverage, shadow/midtone/highlight balance and dark recesses. Do not bleach flesh, brighten skin, add glossy shine, glowing rimlight, blur, grain, painterly gradients, 3D rendering or extra fine detail. Colored export fringe specks on master are not features to redraw.
Same slightly elevated FRONT or REAR game projection as input1, with parallel square-grid axes. Not profile, not a top-down view, not an isometric diamond.
Genuine transparent alphaZERO outside each whole figure and through gaps. No scenery, floor, shadow, matte, grid lines, text, labels or watermark. Do not invent a weapon, clothing, armor or anatomy.
SUBJECT: the low dark RUST RED quadruped with FOUR clawed weight-bearing legs, pale ochre/ivory shoulder and thigh patches, long dark claws and the thin curved dark red tail. Preserve the long hunched back and the small low head, not a new upright face. Tail curves toward image RIGHT in frontal view, image LEFT in rear view. Keep its total silhouette ratio close to 67 wide / 46 high. No wings, no held weapon. Gait: slow four-support walk, not bipedal walking or a leaping dog trot. 1front-left paw reaches low with rear-right advancing, 2front-left settles with three contacts, 3rear-right sets down while front-right unloads, 4front-right passes close to ground, 5front-right/rear-left contact, 6weight settles, 7rear-left contact/front-left unloads, 8front-left passes low to repeat. At least three paws support most of cycle. Very small tail counter-sway from the same attached root.
Input2 is an ACCEPTED QUADRUPED contact/support timing guide ONLY. Keep its low grounded support intervals; do NOT copy its shell, colors, head or proportions.
VIEW: FRONT / walking DOWN toward viewer. Keep the master front silhouette, face and ventral materials.
